title: Pilonidal sinus removal
what: The surgeon removes a tract under the skin above the tailbone, where hair collects and inflammation can occur.
why: When there is a tract above the tailbone that gets inflamed, hurts, or leaks pus.
duration: surgery usually takes 30 to 60 minutes; you usually go home the same day or after 1 to 3 days. Healing takes from a few weeks
tell_doctor: All your medicines, especially blood thinners. Your doctor will say what to do
If it is inflamed and you have a fever right now

prepare.title: Timing
prepare.text: If there is strong inflammation now, the abscess is usually drained first, and the planned surgery is done later.

prepare.title: Tests
prepare.text: Blood tests. The clinic will give you a list.

prepare.title: Food
prepare.text: With general or spinal anesthesia, usually no food from the night before and no drinks for a few hours. The clinic will tell you the exact time.

bring: Documents and a list of your medicines
steps: You change, and an IV line is placed
The surgeon removes the tract along with the affected skin
The wound is stitched, or left open to heal
feel: Pain in the wound, especially when sitting. You will get painkillers
Sitting is uncomfortable for the first weeks
after: Dressing changes on your doctor's schedule
For the first weeks, sit less, and use a soft cushion as your doctor advises
Keep the area clean and dry
Removing hair around the area is sometimes advised, so it does not come back
red_flags: Redness, swelling, or pus in the wound

faq.a: Sometimes. The risk is lower if you follow hygiene and your doctor's advice.
Usually after a few weeks, once the wound heals. Your surgeon will say when.

reminders.text: Pilonidal surgery tomorrow. Take a shower and pack your documents. Eat and drink only until the time the clinic gave you.
